newsitem.title: USA: Maxwell House to raise retail coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: Maxwell House to raise retail coffee prices.

text.p: Maxwell House Coffee Co, a division of Phiip Morris Cos Inc, said it will raise the list price on its standard ground 13-ounce can of coffee by 15 cents due to higher prices of green coffee on the world's futures markets.
The increase, which is to take effect on March 31, brings the new price for a standard can to $2.41, the company said.
Maxwell House also announced it will raise its list price on all its decaffeinated coffees, with its 13-ounce can of decaffeinated coffee increasing by 10 cents to $3.11.
Instant coffee will go up 1.25 cents per ounce to $3.66 per eight-ounce can, they said.
General Foods International flavored coffee, Maxwell House Cappucino and Maxwell House single packets of coffee will remain the same, a spokewoman said.
Maxwell House is a division of Kraft Foods, the multinational food business of Philip Morris.
